description: Compile a spec and write <path>.png (the texture), <path>.skin.json (the source) and optionally <path>.sheet.png into the workspace (/tmp/churn-sfq0snbp). Also writes every other file the texture is in game: a block's <path>_top.png / _side.png…, an animation's strip with <path>.png.mcmeta, a particle's <path>_0.png…, the glowing pixels as <path>_eyes.png. Refuses specs with errors.

path.description: Output path without extension, relative to the workspace, e.g. "skins/frost-mage".

spec.description: A Texel skin spec (version 1) as a JSON object or JSON text. Format: texel://docs/spec, schema: texel://schema/skinspec.v1

name: texel_save
title: Save skin
